digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle verification and policy enforcement
propositions: Enable both material-pin and close-review enforcement policies in rebar.toml while retaining false defaults in the reusable configuration schema
Prove direct and transitive invalidation behavior only occurs after actual material changes through end-to-end lifecycle tests
Demonstrate that unchanged successful re-review does not propagate further invalidation downstream
Verify that execution-phase self-edits invalidate close until a fresh execution review is performed
Confirm that depends_on and blocks references normalize to one canonical prerequisite pin/evaluation

Test that legacy unpinned attestations, enable/disable/re-enable cycles, deleted/archived targets, and audited force-close all function correctly under both policies without eager backfill or graph-wide invalidation events
